specs.Operating System: Chrome OS, Linux, Mac OS, Raspberry Pi OS, Windows 10, Windows 2000, Windows 7, Windows Vista

features: Wireless connection: The Zeb-Companion 107 wireless keyboard and mouse combo offers a dependable 2.4GHz wireless connection.
Keys: The keyboard is equipped with 104 keys including a Rupee key (₹), catering to users in regions using the Indian Rupee currency.
Multimedia keys: The Zeb-Companion 107 includes 12 integrated multimedia keys for media control and enhancing overall usability.
UV-print keys: The keycaps are UV-printed, ensuring durability and resistance against wear and tear.
High-precision: The Zeb-Companion 107 mouse is as advanced as the keyboard with its advanced optical sensor for precise working.
3 buttons: The mouse comes with 3 buttons - right, left, and middle scroll button
1200 DPI: The mouse comes with an advanced optical sensor of 1200 DPI for efficient working.
USB nano receiver: The USB nano receiver in the combo allows for plug-and-play making it easier to use.
Power Saving mode: For power-saving, the ZEB-Companion 107 mouse comes with a dedicated On/off power button.
